status: frozen before new coupled-ending counts; exploratory reused source, not blind confirmation
artifact_key: nonmissing cisi else lipi_id:+id before first dot; missing markers empty,-,--,?,None,Unknown
artifact_scope: Exact SEAL:S source type only, all rows in each group validated before site selection. Exclude group if any parse_lipi-invalid row, or more than one exact sequence/site. Require exact Mohenjo-daro site. No singleton NR exception.
unit: One distinct complete native W sequence, with all eligible artifact/row witnesses retained. Require length>=3. End is last two signs in stored source order, not established historical word ending.
statistic: For unordered ending pairs ((x,y),(u,v)) with x!=u AND y!=v, count distinct nonempty exact preceding stems with both endings attested. Repeated artifacts and duplicate edges cannot inflate counts.
null: Uniformly shuffle intact two-sign endings across fixed stem slots within exact total length. Preserve atomic-ending frequency, stem-slot multiplicity and total length. Collisions allowed and collapsed only for statistic.
support: For each coupled pair and length l, achievable supported stems=min(number of stems with >=2 slots, count(endingA), count(endingB)); sum over lengths. This is an exact maximum per pair, not a simultaneous maximum or power. If every pair maximum<2, stop as insufficient support.
correction: Each permutation maximum is over every coupled ending pair it forms, including pairs unobserved in original arrangement. maxT p=(1+number of null maxima>=observed support)/(B+1). Global joint-exchangeability calibration only; no strong partial-null pairwise FWER claim.
selection: Observed support>=2 AND maxT p<=0.01. At most5 pairs sorted descending support then lexical ending pair.
early_stop: If no observed coupled pair has support>=2, stop with zero candidates and no Monte Carlo; mark uncomputed p values null. If global null maximum is sampled constant, report that explicitly, not a power conclusion.
followup: Only if selected pairs exist, primary-check up to5 selected pairs from retained scans and preserve all required witnesses/unknowns. No new public artifact search. No namespace mapping without existing authenticated glyph evidence. No claims of independent replication.
stop: One site/type/parser/terminal width, one support calculation and one null run if eligible. No alternative boundaries, merging, sign families, other sites or relaxed thresholds after outcomes.
reopening: New independently justified data or a documented implementation defect; nonsignificance alone does not authorize design changes.
